newsitem.title: USA: Sprint in talks on $49 mln Ohio contract.
newsitem.headline: Sprint in talks on $49 mln Ohio contract.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Friday that it has been selected by the Ohio Public Utilities Commission for final negotiations on a $49 million, five-year contract to provide telecommunications relay services to Ohio's deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind and speech disabled consumers.
Sprint said it was chosen over three other bidders and will negotiate a final contract with the commission staff.
The company did not say when it expected the talks to result in a final contract.

Sprint's proposal calls for the company to open an around-the-clock telecommunications relay center, which is expected to employ as many as 200 people in full-time and part-time positions after service begins in January 1998. The exact location of the center in Ohio is among the items still under discussion.
